To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the WMAP data alone and the combination of the WMAP and CBI data are consistent with a flat universe that is dominated by dark energy.
the WMAP data, combined with other cosmological measurements, provide strong evidence for a flat universe that is dominated by cold dark matter and dark energy.
the WMAP data, combined with the 2dF galaxy redshift survey, provide a precise determination of the cosmological parameters of the flat, cold dark matter, vacuum energy model.
